subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word.

Indians tend to be quite __conservative__ in most aspects of life, particularly in rural areas.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"conservative"** means holding to traditional attitudes and values and cautious about change or innovation. (रूढ़िवादी)

 
 
• **Example: **Many older people tend to be **conservative** in their views on marriage.
 
 
 
• **"Liberal"** refers to being open to new behavior or opinions and willing to discard traditional values. (उदार)
 
 
• **Example: **She has a** liberal **attitude towards modern art and music.
 
 

Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'conservative'** is **'liberal'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Fantastic** (शानदार): Extraordinarily good or attractive.

 
 
• **Example:** She had a **fantastic **time at the concert.
 
 
 
• **Determined** (दृढ़): Having made a firm decision and being resolved not to change it.
 
 
• **Example: **He is **determined **to finish his project by tonight.
 
 
 
• **Authentic** (प्रामाणिक): Of undisputed origin and not a copy; genuine.
 
 
• **Example:** She prefers **authentic** cuisine over fast food.
